name: Lionroar Crew
headerMeta: Golden era · Ranged Infantry · cannon artillery · 325 leadership · Seasonal (S20: Lionfire)
pitch: A slow, high-impact exotic unit that places deployable cannons to control objectives and deny enemy positioning. Demands strict teamwork and protection — without cover it crumbles, but well-positioned it unlocks map strategies unavailable to conventional infantry.

battleRole.positioning: Protect the crew — keep it behind your frontline, especially when cannons are deployed. Position cannons to control chokepoints and high-value map objectives. {1}
battleRole.tips: Unit excels at taking out map structures (the bridge on Wall Fort, gates in other maps) even after tower-destruction nerfs, unlocking new strategies. {1} Pair with other units for protection; it alone will not survive focused fire. {1}
